crossRefs.note: I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, and multiply my signs and my wonders in the land of Egypt.

It will happen, when many evils and troubles have come on them, that this song will testify before them as a witness…
You know my sitting down and my rising up. You perceive my thoughts from afar.
For there is not a word on my tongue, but, behold, Yahweh, you know it altogether.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Pharaoh will say of the children of Israel, ‘They are entangled in the land. The wilderness has shut them in.’
translations.bsb: For Pharaoh will say of the Israelites, ‘They are wandering the land in confusion; the wilderness has boxed them in.’
translations.kjv: For Pharaoh will say of the children of Israel, They are entangled in the land, the wilderness hath shut them in.
translations.asv: And Pharaoh will say of the children of Israel, They are entangled in the land, the wilderness hath shut them in.
